venue.name: Dartford Mayor charity tea
venue.subject: Fwd: Mayor of Dartford afternoon tea

messages.subject: Fwd: Mayor of Dartford afternoon tea
messages.body:
Hi Jake,
My husband John left a enquiry on the Worldwide Entertainers.
I understand that there will be no problems for you contractually away from this site? I wouldn't want to I create any difficulties for you.
As you know , I really like your voice , and would like to book you to this occasion, if you are happy to accept the fee of £100. As I mentioned, this is a charity fundraising event. We will have several Mayor's and dignitaries from around Kent in attendance. You can tell me how you normally work , but we will not want music that will drown out the conversation. Maybe later when everyone has enjoyed the food and speeches ( one or two) and raffles have taken place, the audience might enjoy just listening to something little livelier.
We do have a PA system on site , unless you prefer your own.
The event is advertised from 3pm to 5:30pm, so most will start arriving 2:30 ish
Let me know what you think!
Thank you
Eija Burrell

messages.subject: Fwd: Mayor of Dartford afternoon tea
messages.body:
Hi Eija,

Friday 27 November is confirmed & in the diary.

Happy to do £100 for the charity afternoon tea. I'll get there earlier to set up — can you confirm what time you want me to actually start singing?

Happy to use your PA on site — I'll bring mine as well just in case.

I'd suggest about 30–40 minutes of soft background music while people eat and chat, then 30–40 minutes more upbeat once the food, speeches and raffle are done.

I've got the event as Mayor of Dartford afternoon tea — please confirm the venue address when you can.

Thanks,
Jake

messages.subject: Fwd: Mayor of Dartford afternoon tea
messages.body:
Hi Jake,
Thank you. Consider the booking confirmed!
Address is: Claire Tiltman Centre, Gantry Place, Cotton Lane, Stone,
Greenhithe DA9 9FA.
I think you have understood well what we wanted. Do you have more of your
sets online for us to listen to?
And let me know what the normal process for payment is? Deposit and
remainder on the day?
How long does it take for you to set up? You might want to test every thing
beforehand. I expect l will be there from around 13:30pm onwards.
If there is anything else you need to know, please let me know!
Thank you
Eija

messages.subject: Fwd: Mayor of Dartford afternoon tea
messages.body:
Hi Eija,

Perfect — I've got Claire Tiltman Centre, Gantry Place, Cotton Lane, Stone, Greenhithe DA9 9FA locked in.

Yes — there's more footage on my Instagram: http://instagram.com/jakeessexmusic

For payment on this one: no deposit. Just the £100 cash on the day is fine.

Setup usually takes about 20–30 minutes, so arriving from 13:30 works well for me — gives me time to test everything before guests arrive.

If anything else comes up before the day, just shout.

Thanks,
Jake
